question_tet: Saida mak ema nia objetivu prinsipál?
question_en: What is the chief end of man?
answer_tet: Ema nia objetivu prinsipál mak atu fó glória ba Maromak, no haksolok iha Nia ba nafatin.
answer_en: Man's chief end is to glorify God, and to enjoy him forever.

question_tet: Regra ida ne'ebé mak Maromak fó tiha ona atu dirije ita oinsá ita bele fó glória no haksolok iha Nia?
question_en: What rule has God given to direct us how we may glorify and enjoy him?
answer_tet: Maromak nia Liafuan, ne'ebé iha Eskritura Testamentu Tuan no Foun nian, mak regra mesak ida de'it atu dirije ita oinsá ita bele fó glória no haksolok iha Nia.
answer_en: The Word of God, which is contained in the Scriptures of the Old and New Testaments, is the only rule to direct us how we may glorify and enjoy him.

question_tet: Saida mak Eskritura sira hanorin liuliu?
question_en: What do the Scriptures principally teach?
answer_tet: Eskritura sira hanorin liuliu saida mak ema tenke fiar kona-ba Maromak, no dever saida mak Maromak husu hosi ema.
answer_en: The Scriptures principally teach, what man is to believe concerning God, and what duty God requires of man.

question_tet: Maromak mak saida?
question_en: What is God?
answer_tet: Maromak mak Espíritu ida, ne'ebé laiha balun, eternu, no la troka iha Ninia essénsia, sabedóuria, podér, santidade, justisa, di'ak, no lia-loos.
answer_en: God is a Spirit, infinite, eternal, and unchangeable, in his being, wisdom, power, holiness, justice, goodness, and truth.

question_tet: Iha Maromak liu hosi ida ka?
question_en: Are there more Gods than one?
answer_tet: Iha de'it Maromak ida mesak, ne'ebé moris no loos.
answer_en: There is but one only, the living and true God.

question_tet: Pessoa hira mak iha Trindade Maromak nian?
question_en: How many persons are there in the Godhead?
answer_tet: Iha pessoa tolu iha Trindade Maromak nian: Aman, Oan, no Espíritu Santu; no pessoa tolu ne'e mak Maromak ida de'it, hanesan iha substánsia, no hanesan iha podér no glória.
answer_en: There are three persons in the Godhead; the Father, the Son, and the Holy Ghost; and these three are one God, the same in substance, equal in power and glory.

question_tet: Saida mak Maromak nia dekretu sira?
question_en: What are the decrees of God?
answer_tet: Maromak nia dekretu sira mak Ninia propózitu eternu, tuir konsellu hosi Ninia hakarak, ho ida-ne'e, ba Ninia glória rasik, Nia ordenu tiha ona buat hotu-hotu ne'ebé akontese.
answer_en: The decrees of God are, his eternal purpose, according to the counsel of his will, whereby, for his own glory, he hath foreordained whatsoever comes to pass.

question_tet: Oinsá mak Maromak hala'o Ninia dekretu sira?
question_en: How doth God execute his decrees?
answer_tet: Maromak hala'o Ninia dekretu sira iha servisu kriasaun nian no providénsia nian.
answer_en: God executeth his decrees in the works of creation and providence.

question_tet: Saida mak servisu kriasaun nian?
question_en: What is the work of creation?
answer_tet: Servisu kriasaun nian mak Maromak halo buat hotu-hotu hosi laiha buat ida, liuhosi Ninia Liafuan podér nian, iha loron neen nia laran, no buat hotu-hotu di'ak tebes.
answer_en: The work of creation is, God's making all things of nothing, by the word of his power, in the space of six days, and all very good.

question_tet: Oinsá mak Maromak kria ema?
question_en: How did God create man?
answer_tet: Maromak kria ema nu'udar mane no feto, tuir Ninia imajen rasik, iha koñesimentu, justisa, no santidade, ho domíniu iha kriatura sira-nia leten.
answer_en: God created man male and female, after his own image, in knowledge, righteousness, and holiness, with dominion over the creatures.

question_tet: Saida mak Maromak nia servisu providénsia nian?
question_en: What are God's works of providence?
answer_tet: Maromak nia servisu providénsia nian mak Ninia hahalok ne'ebé santu tebes, ho sabedóuria no podér, hodi preserva no ukun Ninia kriatura hotu-hotu no sira-nia hahalok hotu-hotu.
answer_en: God's works of providence are, his most holy, wise, and powerful preserving and governing all his creatures, and all their actions.

question_tet: Saida mak Maromak nia servisu providénsia espesiál ne'ebé Nia hatudu ba ema iha kondisaun ne'ebé nia hetan kria?
question_en: What special act of providence did God exercise toward man in the estate wherein he was created?
answer_tet: Bainhira Maromak kria tiha ema, Nia halo aliansa moris nian ho nia, ho kondisaun obediénsia perfeitu; hodi proibí nia atu keta han ai-fuan hosi ai-hun koñesimentu di'ak no aat nian, ho kastigu mate.
answer_en: When God had created man, he entered into a covenant of life with him, upon condition of perfect obedience; forbidding him to eat of the tree of the knowledge of good and evil, upon the pain of death.

question_tet: Ita-nia bei'ala dahuluk sira hela beibeik iha kondisaun ne'ebé sira hetan kria ka?
question_en: Did our first parents continue in the estate wherein they were created?
answer_tet: Ita-nia bei'ala dahuluk sira, husik ba sira-nia hakarak rasik nia liberdade, monu tiha hosi kondisaun ne'ebé sira hetan kria, liuhosi halo sala hasoru Maromak.
answer_en: Our first parents, being left to the freedom of their own will, fell from the estate wherein they were created, by sinning against God.

question_tet: Saida mak sala?
question_en: What is sin?
answer_tet: Sala mak falta ruma atu tuir, ka violasaun ruma hasoru Maromak nia lei.
answer_en: Sin is any want of conformity unto, or transgression of, the law of God.

question_tet: Saida mak sala ne'ebé halo ita-nia bei'ala dahuluk sira monu hosi kondisaun ne'ebé sira hetan kria?
question_en: What was the sin whereby our first parents fell from the estate wherein they were created?
answer_tet: Sala ne'ebé halo ita-nia bei'ala dahuluk sira monu hosi kondisaun ne'ebé sira hetan kria mak sira-nia han ai-fuan ne'ebé proibidu.
answer_en: The sin whereby our first parents fell from the estate wherein they were created, was their eating the forbidden fruit.

question_tet: Mundu nia ema hotu-hotu monu iha Adão nia violasaun dahuluk ka?
question_en: Did all mankind fall in Adam's first transgression?
answer_tet: Bainhira aliansa halo tiha ho Adão, la'ós ba nia an rasik de'it, maibé mós ba ninia jerasaun; ema hotu-hotu ne'ebé mai hosi nia tuir jerasaun baibain, halo sala iha nia no monu hamutuk ho nia iha ninia violasaun dahuluk.
answer_en: The covenant being made with Adam, not only for himself, but for his posterity; all mankind, descending from him by ordinary generation, sinned in him, and fell with him, in his first transgression.

question_tet: Ba iha kondisaun ne'ebé mak monu ne'e lori ema hotu-hotu?
question_en: Into what estate did the fall bring mankind?
answer_tet: Monu ne'e lori ema hotu-hotu ba iha kondisaun sala no mizeria nian.
answer_en: The fall brought mankind into an estate of sin and misery.

question_tet: Saida mak naklahat iha kondisaun sala nian ne'ebé ema monu ba?
question_en: Wherein consists the sinfulness of that estate whereinto man fell?
answer_tet: Kondisaun sala nian ne'ebé ema monu ba naklahat iha Adão nia sala dahuluk nia kulpa, falta justisa orijinál nian, no korrupsaun hosi ninia natureza tomak, ne'ebé baibain hanaran pekadu orijinál; hamutuk ho violasaun atuál hotu-hotu ne'ebé sai hosi ne'e.
answer_en: The sinfulness of that estate whereinto man fell, consists in the guilt of Adam's first sin, the want of original righteousness, and the corruption of his whole nature, which is commonly called original sin; together with all actual transgressions which proceed from it.

question_tet: Saida mak mizeria hosi kondisaun ne'ebé ema monu ba?
question_en: What is the misery of that estate whereinto man fell?
answer_tet: Ema hotu-hotu liuhosi sira-nia monu lakon komuñaun ho Maromak, hela iha Ninia hirus no malisan okos, no sai sujeitu ba mizeria hotu-hotu iha moris ne'e, ba mate rasik, no ba terus infernu nian ba nafatin.
answer_en: All mankind, by their fall, lost communion with God, are under his wrath and curse, and so made liable to all miseries in this life, to death itself, and to the pains of hell for ever.

question_tet: Maromak husik ema hotu-hotu atu lakon iha kondisaun sala no mizeria nian ka?
question_en: Did God leave all mankind to perish in the estate of sin and misery?
answer_tet: Maromak, liuhosi Ninia haksolok laran-di'ak nian de'it, hosi eternidade tomak, hili tiha balun ba moris rohan-la'ek, tama tiha iha aliansa grasa nian atu liberta sira hosi kondisaun sala no mizeria nian, no lori sira ba kondisaun salvasaun nian liuhosi Salvadór ida.
answer_en: God having, out of his mere good pleasure, from all eternity, elected some to everlasting life, did enter into a covenant of grace, to deliver them out of the estate of sin and misery, and to bring them into an estate of salvation by a Redeemer.

question_tet: Sé mak Redentór hosi Maromak nia ema hili-sira?
question_en: Who is the Redeemer of God's elect?
answer_tet: Redentór mesak ida de'it hosi Maromak nia ema hili-sira mak Na'i Jesuis Kristu, ne'ebé nu'udar Maromak nia Oan-Mane eternu, sai tiha ema, no nune'i husi uluk ho ba nafatin, Nia mak Maromak no ema iha natureza ketak rua, no pessoa ida de'it, ba nafatin.
answer_en: The only Redeemer of God's elect is the Lord Jesus Christ, who, being the eternal Son of God, became man, and so was, and continueth to be, God and man in two distinct natures, and one person, forever.

question_tet: Oinsá mak Kristu, nu'udar Maromak nia Oan-Mane, sai ema?
question_en: How did Christ, being the Son of God, become man?
answer_tet: Kristu, Maromak nia Oan-Mane, sai ema liuhosi foti ba Nia an isin ne'ebé loos no klamar ne'ebé ho razaun, hetan koñsebe liuhosi Espíritu Santu nia podér iha virjem Maria nia kabun laran, no moris hosi nia, maibé laiha sala.
answer_en: Christ, the Son of God, became man, by taking to himself a true body, and a reasonable soul, being conceived by the power of the Holy Ghost, in the womb of the virgin Mary, and born of her, yet without sin.

question_tet: Ofísiu hira mak Kristu hala'o nu'udar ita-nia Redentór?
question_en: What offices doth Christ execute as our Redeemer?
answer_tet: Kristu, nu'udar ita-nia Redentór, hala'o ofísiu profeta nian, amululik nian, no liurai nian, maski iha Ninia kondisaun haraik-an nian no mós foti-an nian.
answer_en: Christ, as our Redeemer, executeth the offices of a prophet, of a priest, and of a king, both in his estate of humiliation and exaltation.

question_tet: Oinsá mak Kristu hala'o ofísiu profeta nian?
question_en: How doth Christ execute the office of a prophet?
answer_tet: Kristu hala'o ofísiu profeta nian liuhosi revelar mai ita, liuhosi Ninia Liafuan no Espíritu, Maromak nia hakarak ba ita-nia salvasaun.
answer_en: Christ executeth the office of a prophet, in revealing to us, by his Word and Spirit, the will of God for our salvation.

question_tet: Oinsá mak Kristu hala'o ofísiu amululik nian?
question_en: How doth Christ execute the office of a priest?
answer_tet: Kristu hala'o ofísiu amululik nian liuhosi offera dala ida de'it Ninia an nu'udar sakrifísiu ida atu satisfás justisa divina, no rekonsilia ita ho Maromak; no liuhosi halo interseasaun beibeik ba ita.
answer_en: Christ executeth the office of a priest, in his once offering up of himself a sacrifice to satisfy divine justice, and reconcile us to God; and in making continual intercession for us.

question_tet: Oinsá mak Kristu hala'o ofísiu liurai nian?
question_en: How doth Christ execute the office of a king?
answer_tet: Kristu hala'o ofísiu liurai nian liuhosi subjuga ita ba Ninia an, ukun no defende ita, no kesi no manán Ninia inimigu hotu-hotu no ita-nia inimigu sira.
answer_en: Christ executeth the office of a king, in subduing us to himself, in ruling and defending us, and in restraining and conquering all his and our enemies.

question_tet: Saida mak naklahat iha Kristu nia haraik-an?
question_en: Wherein did Christ's humiliation consist?
answer_tet: Kristu nia haraik-an naklahat iha Ninia moris iha kondisaun haraik-an nian, kria iha lei okos, hassan mizeria moris ne'e nian, Maromak nia hirus, no mate malisan iha krús kruzifikadu; iha hakoi-an, no hela iha mate nia podér okos ba tempu balun.
answer_en: Christ's humiliation consisted in his being born, and that in a low condition, made under the law, undergoing the miseries of this life, the wrath of God, and the cursed death of the cross; in being buried, and continuing under the power of death for a time.

question_tet: Saida mak naklahat iha Kristu nia foti-an?
question_en: Wherein consisteth Christ's exaltation?
answer_tet: Kristu nia foti-an naklahat iha Ninia moris hi'as hosi mate iha loron terseiru, sa'e ba lalehan, tur iha Maromak Aman nia liman-kuana, no mai fali atu tesi-lia ba mundu iha loron ikus.
answer_en: Christ's exaltation consisteth in his rising again from the dead on the third day, in ascending up into heaven, in sitting at the right hand of God the Father, and in coming to judge the world at the last day.

question_tet: Oinsá mak ita sai partisipante ba redensaun ne'ebé sosa tiha hosi Kristu?
question_en: How are we made partakers of the redemption purchased by Christ?
answer_tet: Ita sai partisipante ba redensaun ne'ebé sosa tiha hosi Kristu liuhosi aplikasaun efetivu hosi ne'e mai ita liuhosi Ninia Espíritu Santu.
answer_en: We are made partakers of the redemption purchased by Christ, by the effectual application of it to us by his Holy Spirit.

question_tet: Oinsá mak Espíritu Santu aplika mai ita redensaun ne'ebé sosa tiha hosi Kristu?
question_en: How doth the Spirit apply to us the redemption purchased by Christ?
answer_tet: Espíritu Santu aplika mai ita redensaun ne'ebé sosa tiha hosi Kristu liuhosi kria fiar iha ita-nia laran, no liuhosi ne'e unifika ita ho Kristu iha ita-nia xamada efetiva.
answer_en: The Spirit applyeth to us the redemption purchased by Christ, by working faith in us, and thereby uniting us to Christ in our effectual calling.

question_tet: Saida mak xamada efetiva?
question_en: What is effectual calling?
answer_tet: Xamada efetiva mak servisu Espíritu Maromak nian, ne'ebé, konvense ita kona-ba ita-nia sala no mizeria, klarea ita-nia hanoin iha koñesimentu Kristu nian, no renova ita-nia hakarak, Nia perswade no kapasita ita atu simu Jesuis Kristu, ne'ebé fó gratuitamentu mai ita iha evanjellu.
answer_en: Effectual calling is the work of God's Spirit, whereby, convincing us of our sin and misery, enlightening our minds in the knowledge of Christ, and renewing our wills, he doth persuade and enable us to embrace Jesus Christ, freely offered to us in the gospel.

question_tet: Benefísiu sira-ne'ebé mak ema sira-ne'ebé simu xamada efetiva hetan iha moris ne'e?
question_en: What benefits do they that are effectually called partake of in this life?
answer_tet: Ema sira-ne'ebé simu xamada efetiva hetan iha moris ne'e justifikasaun, adosaun, no santifikasaun, hamutuk ho benefísiu oioin ne'ebé iha moris ne'e la'o hamutuk ka suli hosi sira-ne'e.
answer_en: They that are effectually called do in this life partake of justification, adoption, and sanctification, and the several benefits which in this life do either accompany or flow from them.

question_tet: Saida mak justifikasaun?
question_en: What is justification?
answer_tet: Justifikasaun mak hahalok ida hosi Maromak nia grasa gratuitu, ne'ebé Nia perdua ita-nia sala hotu-hotu, no simu ita nu'udar ema justu iha Ninia oin, de'it liuhosi Kristu nia justisa ne'ebé atribui mai ita, no simu liuhosi fiar de'it.
answer_en: Justification is an act of God's free grace, wherein he pardoneth all our sins, and accepteth us as righteous in his sight, only for the righteousness of Christ imputed to us, and received by faith alone.

question_tet: Saida mak adosaun?
question_en: What is adoption?
answer_tet: Adosaun mak hahalok ida hosi Maromak nia grasa gratuitu, liuhosi ne'e ita hetan simu ba iha Maromak nia oan sira-nia numeru, no hetan direitu ba priviléjiu hotu-hotu hosi Maromak nia oan sira.
answer_en: Adoption is an act of God's free grace, whereby we are received into the number, and have a right to all the privileges of the sons of God.

question_tet: Saida mak santifikasaun?
question_en: What is sanctification?
answer_tet: Santifikasaun mak servisu hosi Maromak nia grasa gratuitu, liuhosi ne'e ita hetan renova iha ema tomak nia laran tuir Maromak nia imajen, no hetan kapasita liután atu mate ba sala, no moris ba justisa.
answer_en: Sanctification is the work of God's free grace, whereby we are renewed in the whole man after the image of God, and are enabled more and more to die unto sin, and live unto righteousness.

question_tet: Saida mak benefísiu sira-ne'ebé iha moris ne'e la'o hamutuk ka suli hosi justifikasaun, adosaun, no santifikasaun?
question_en: What are the benefits which in this life do accompany or flow from justification, adoption, and sanctification?
answer_tet: Benefísiu sira-ne'ebé iha moris ne'e la'o hamutuk ka suli hosi justifikasaun, adosaun, no santifikasaun, mak: garantia hosi Maromak nia domin, pás hosi konsiénsia, haksolok iha Espíritu Santu, aumentu hosi grasa, no perseveransa iha ne'e to'o rohan.
answer_en: The benefits which in this life do accompany or flow from justification, adoption, and sanctification, are, assurance of God's love, peace of conscience, joy in the Holy Ghost, increase of grace, and perseverance therein to the end.

question_tet: Benefísiu sira-ne'ebé mak ema fiar-sira simu hosi Kristu iha mate nia tempu?
question_en: What benefits do believers receive from Christ at death?
answer_tet: Ema fiar-sira-nia klamar iha sira-nia mate hetan halo perfeitu iha santidade, no kedas husik tama ba glória; no sira-nia isin, tanba sei unidu nafatin ho Kristu, deskansa iha sira-nia rate to'o rezurreisaun.
answer_en: The souls of believers are at their death made perfect in holiness, and do immediately pass into glory; and their bodies, being still united to Christ, do rest in their graves till the resurrection.

question_tet: Benefísiu sira-ne'ebé mak ema fiar-sira simu hosi Kristu iha rezurreisaun nia tempu?
question_en: What benefits do believers receive from Christ at the resurrection?
answer_tet: Iha rezurreisaun nia tempu, ema fiar-sira foti hi'as iha glória, sei hetan koñese nakloke no hetan absolvisaun iha loron juízu nian, no hetan halo hura-hura perfeitu iha goza tomak hosi Maromak ba eternidade tomak.
answer_en: At the resurrection, believers being raised up in glory, shall be openly acknowledged and acquitted in the day of judgment, and made perfectly blessed in the full enjoying of God to all eternity.

question_tet: Saida mak dever ne'ebé Maromak husu hosi ema?
question_en: What is the duty which God requireth of man?
answer_tet: Dever ne'ebé Maromak husu hosi ema mak obediénsia ba Ninia hakarak ne'ebé revelar tiha ona.
answer_en: The duty which God requireth of man, is obedience to his revealed will.

question_tet: Saida mak Maromak revelar dahuluk ba ema nu'udar regra ba ninia obediénsia?
question_en: What did God at first reveal to man for the rule of his obedience?
answer_tet: Regra ne'ebé Maromak revelar dahuluk ba ema ba ninia obediénsia, mak lei morál.
answer_en: The rule which God at first revealed to man for his obedience, was the moral law.

question_tet: Iha ne'ebé mak lei morál hetan rezumu hamutuk?
question_en: Where is the moral law summarily comprehended?
answer_tet: Lei morál hetan rezumu hamutuk iha ukun-fuan nulu sira.
answer_en: The moral law is summarily comprehended in the ten commandments.

question_tet: Saida mak rezumu hosi ukun-fuan nulu sira?
question_en: What is the sum of the ten commandments?
answer_tet: Rezumu hosi ukun-fuan nulu sira mak, atu habadinas no doben Na'i ita-nia Maromak ho ita-nia laran tomak, ho ita-nia klamar tomak, ho ita-nia kbiit tomak, no ho ita-nia hanoin tomak; no ita-nia prosimu hanesan ita-nia an rasik.
answer_en: The sum of the ten commandments is, to love the Lord our God with all our heart, with all our soul, with all our strength, and with all our mind; and our neighbor as ourselves.

question_tet: Saida mak lia-maklokek ba ukun-fuan nulu sira?
question_en: What is the preface to the ten commandments?
answer_tet: Lia-maklokek ba ukun-fuan nulu sira mak iha liafuan sira-ne'e: Ha'u mak Na'i ó-nia Maromak, ne'ebé lori tiha ó sai hosi rai Ejiptu, hosi uma atan nian.
answer_en: The preface to the ten commandments is in these words, I am the Lord thy God, which have brought thee out of the land of Egypt, out of the house of bondage.

question_tet: Saida mak lia-maklokek ba ukun-fuan nulu sira hanorin ita?
question_en: What doth the preface to the ten commandments teach us?
answer_tet: Lia-maklokek ba ukun-fuan nulu sira hanorin ita katak, tanba Maromak mak Na'i, no ita-nia Maromak, no Redentór, tan ne'e ita tenke hali'is no hato'o Ninia ukun-fuan hotu-hotu.
answer_en: The preface to the ten commandments teacheth us, that because God is the Lord, and our God, and Redeemer, therefore we are bound to keep all his commandments.

question_tet: Ukun-fuan ne'ebé mak ukun-fuan dahuluk?
question_en: Which is the first commandment?
answer_tet: Ukun-fuan dahuluk mak: Ó keta iha maromak seluk iha Ha'u-nia oin.
answer_en: The first commandment is, Thou shalt have no other gods before me.

question_tet: Saida mak hetan husu iha ukun-fuan dahuluk?
question_en: What is required in the first commandment?
answer_tet: Ukun-fuan dahuluk husu ita atu hatene no rekoniñese Maromak nu'udar Maromak ida mesak ne'ebé loos, no ita-nia Maromak; no atu adora no fó glória ba Nia tuir ne'e.
answer_en: The first commandment requireth us to know and acknowledge God to be the only true God, and our God; and to worship and glorify him accordingly.

question_tet: Saida mak hetan proibí iha ukun-fuan dahuluk?
question_en: What is forbidden in the first commandment?
answer_tet: Ukun-fuan dahuluk proibí nega, ka la adora no la fó glória ba Maromak ne'ebé loos nu'udar Maromak, no ita-nia Maromak; no fó adorasaun no glória ne'e ba seluk ruma, ne'ebé mak de'it ba Nia mesak.
answer_en: The first commandment forbiddeth the denying, or not worshipping and glorifying the true God as God, and our God; and the giving of that worship and glory to any other, which is due to him alone.

question_tet: Saida mak ita hetan hanorin espesialmentu hosi liafuan sira-ne'e "iha Ha'u-nia oin" iha ukun-fuan dahuluk?
question_en: What are we specially taught by these words "before me" in the first commandment?
answer_tet: Liafuan sira-ne'e "iha Ha'u-nia oin" iha ukun-fuan dahuluk hanorin ita katak, Maromak, ne'ebé haree buat hotu-hotu, foti nota no la haksolok tebes ho sala hosi iha maromak seluk ruma.
answer_en: These words "before me" in the first commandment teach us, that God, who seeth all things, taketh notice of, and is much displeased with, the sin of having any other god.

question_tet: Ukun-fuan ne'ebé mak ukun-fuan daruak?
question_en: Which is the second commandment?
answer_tet: Ukun-fuan daruak mak: Ó keta halo ba ó an kualker imajen ho mehi, ka kualker ilas hosi buat ruma ne'ebé iha lalehan iha leten, ka ne'ebé iha rai iha kraik, ka ne'ebé iha bee iha rai-okos: ó keta hakru'uk ba sira, nem servi sira: tanba Ha'u Na'i ó-nia Maromak mak Maromak ciúme ida, ne'ebé selu inikuidade hosi aman sira ba oan sira to'o jerasaun terseiru no kuartu hosi sira-ne'e ne'ebé odiu Ha'u; no hatudu misericórdia ba rihun-rihun hosi sira-ne'e ne'ebé doben Ha'u, no hali'is Ha'u-nia ukun-fuan sira.
answer_en: The second commandment is, Thou shalt not make unto thee any graven image, or any likeness of any thing that is in heaven above, or that is in the earth beneath, or that is in the water under the earth: thou shalt not bow down thyself to them, nor serve them: for I the Lord thy God am a jealous God, visiting the iniquity of the fathers upon the children unto the third and fourth generation of them that hate me; and showing mercy unto thousands of them that love me, and keep my commandments.

question_tet: Saida mak hetan husu iha ukun-fuan daruak?
question_en: What is required in the second commandment?
answer_tet: Ukun-fuan daruak husu simu, observa, no hali'is ho moos no tomak, adorasaun relijioza no ordenansa hotu-hotu ne'ebé Maromak hato'o tiha ona iha Ninia liafuan.
answer_en: The second commandment requireth the receiving, observing, and keeping pure and entire, all such religious worship and ordinances as God hath appointed in his word.

question_tet: Saida mak hetan proibí iha ukun-fuan daruak?
question_en: What is forbidden in the second commandment?
answer_tet: Ukun-fuan daruak proibí adora Maromak liuhosi imajen sira, ka liuhosi dalan seluk ruma ne'ebé la hatato'o iha Ninia liafuan.
answer_en: The second commandment forbiddeth the worshipping of God by images, or any other way not appointed in his word.

question_tet: Saida mak razaun sira-ne'ebé tanba ba ukun-fuan daruak?
question_en: What are the reasons annexed to the second commandment?
answer_tet: Razaun sira-ne'ebé tanba ba ukun-fuan daruak mak Maromak nia soberania iha ita-nia leten, Ninia na'in ba ita, no zelo ne'ebé Nia iha ba Ninia adorasaun rasik.
answer_en: The reasons annexed to the second commandment are, God's sovereignty over us, his propriety in us, and the zeal he hath to his own worship.

question_tet: Ukun-fuan ne'ebé mak ukun-fuan datolu?
question_en: Which is the third commandment?
answer_tet: Ukun-fuan datolu mak: Ó keta lori Na'i ó-nia Maromak nia naran ho leet; tanba Na'i sei la husik laiha kulpa ema ne'ebé lori Ninia naran ho leet.
answer_en: The third commandment is, Thou shalt not take the name of the Lord thy God in vain; for the Lord will not hold him guiltless that taketh his name in vain.

question_tet: Saida mak hetan husu iha ukun-fuan datolu?
question_en: What is required in the third commandment?
answer_tet: Ukun-fuan datolu husu uzu santu no respeitu tebes hosi Maromak nia naran sira, títulu sira, atributu sira, ordenansa sira, liafuan, no servisu sira.
answer_en: The third commandment requireth the holy and reverent use of God's names, titles, attributes, ordinances, word, and works.

question_tet: Saida mak hetan proibí iha ukun-fuan datolu?
question_en: What is forbidden in the third commandment?
answer_tet: Ukun-fuan datolu proibí profanasaun ka abuzu hotu-hotu hosi buat ruma ne'ebé liuhosi ne'e Maromak halo Ninia an hetan koñese.
answer_en: The third commandment forbiddeth all profaning or abusing of anything whereby God maketh himself known.

question_tet: Saida mak razaun ne'ebé tanba ba ukun-fuan datolu?
question_en: What is the reason annexed to the third commandment?
answer_tet: Razaun ne'ebé tanba ba ukun-fuan datolu mak katak, maski ema ne'ebé harat ukun-fuan ne'e bele halai hosi kastigu ema nian, maibé Na'i ita-nia Maromak sei la husik sira halai hosi Ninia juízu justu.
answer_en: The reason annexed to the third commandment is, that however the breakers of this commandment may escape punishment from men, yet the Lord our God will not suffer them to escape his righteous judgment.

question_tet: Ukun-fuan ne'ebé mak ukun-fuan dafaat?
question_en: Which is the fourth commandment?
answer_tet: Ukun-fuan dafaat mak: Ó hanoin-hetan loron sábadu, atu halo nia santu. Loron neen ó sei servisu, no halo ó-nia servisu hotu-hotu: maibé loron seitu mak sábadu hosi Na'i ó-nia Maromak: iha ne'e ó keta halo servisu ruma, ó, nem ó-nia oan-mane, nem ó-nia oan-feto, ó-nia atan-mane, nem ó-nia atan-feto, nem ó-nia balada, nem ó-nia estranjeiru ne'ebé iha ó-nia odamatan laran: tanba iha loron neen Na'i halo lalehan no rai, tasi, no buat hotu-hotu ne'ebé iha sira-nia laran, no deskansa iha loron seitu: tan ne'e Na'i haraik bensan ba loron sábadu, no halo nia santu.
answer_en: The fourth commandment is, Remember the sabbath day, to keep it holy. Six days shalt thou labor, and do all thy work: but the seventh day is the sabbath of the Lord thy God: in it thou shalt not do any work, thou, nor thy son, nor thy daughter, thy manservant, nor thy maidservant, nor thy cattle, nor thy stranger that is within thy gates: for in six days the Lord made heaven and earth, the sea, and all that in them is, and rested the seventh day: wherefore the Lord blessed the sabbath day, and hallowed it.

question_tet: Saida mak hetan husu iha ukun-fuan dafaat?
question_en: What is required in the fourth commandment?
answer_tet: Ukun-fuan dafaat husu atu hakat santu ba Maromak tempu sira-ne'ebé foti tiha ona ne'ebé Nia hatato'o iha Ninia liafuan; no liuliu loron tomak ida iha seitu nia laran, atu sai sábadu santu ida ba Nia an rasik.
answer_en: The fourth commandment requireth the keeping holy to God such set times as he hath appointed in his word; expressly one whole day in seven, to be a holy sabbath to himself.

question_tet: Loron ne'ebé mak hosi loron seitu ne'e Maromak hatato'o tiha atu sai sábadu semanal?
question_en: Which day of the seven hath God appointed to be the weekly sabbath?
answer_tet: Hosi mundu nia hahuu to'o Kristu nia rezurreisaun, Maromak hatato'o tiha loron seitu hosi mehi atu sai sábadu semanal; no loron dahuluk hosi mehi husi tempu ne'e ba oin, atu kontinua to'o mundu nia rohan, ne'ebé mak sábadu kristaun.
answer_en: From the beginning of the world to the resurrection of Christ, God appointed the seventh day of the week to be the weekly sabbath; and the first day of the week ever since, to continue to the end of the world, which is the Christian sabbath.

question_tet: Oinsá mak sábadu tenke hetan santifika?
question_en: How is the sabbath to be sanctified?
answer_tet: Sábadu tenke hetan santifika liuhosi deskansa santu ida loron tomak ne'e, maski hosi servisu mundanu no rekreasaun sira-ne'ebé legal iha loron seluk sira; no gasta tempu tomak iha mehi adorasaun Maromak nian ne'ebé públiku no privadu, eksatu tan buat ne'ebé foti ba servisu nesezidadi no misericórdia nian.
answer_en: The sabbath is to be sanctified by a holy resting all that day, even from such worldly employments and recreations as are lawful on other days; and spending the whole time in the public and private exercises of God's worship, except so much as is to be taken up in the works of necessity and mercy.

question_tet: Saida mak hetan proibí iha ukun-fuan dafaat?
question_en: What is forbidden in the fourth commandment?
answer_tet: Ukun-fuan dafaat proibí omisaun ka hahalok la matan-moris hosi dever sira-ne'ebé husu, no profanasaun hosi loron ne'e liuhosi baruk, ka halo buat ne'ebé iha nia an rasik mak pekadu, ka liuhosi hanoin, liafuan, ka servisu sira-ne'ebé la nesezáriu kona-ba ita-nia servisu mundanu ka rekreasaun sira.
answer_en: The fourth commandment forbiddeth the omission or careless performance of the duties required, and the profaning the day by idleness, or doing that which is in itself sinful, or by unnecessary thoughts, words, or works, about our worldly employments or recreations.

question_tet: Saida mak razaun sira-ne'ebé tanba ba ukun-fuan dafaat?
question_en: What are the reasons annexed to the fourth commandment?
answer_tet: Razaun sira-ne'ebé tanba ba ukun-fuan dafaat mak Maromak nia fó permite mai ita loron neen iha mehi nia laran ba ita-nia servisu rasik sira, Ninia tuntutan espesiál nian iha loron seitu, Ninia ezemplu rasik, no Ninia haraik bensan ba loron sábadu.
answer_en: The reasons annexed to the fourth commandment are, God's allowing us six days of the week for our own employments, his challenging a special propriety in the seventh, his own example, and his blessing the sabbath day.

question_tet: Ukun-fuan ne'ebé mak ukun-fuan dalima?
question_en: Which is the fifth commandment?
answer_tet: Ukun-fuan dalima mak: Ó hamtauk no hahi'i ó-nia aman no ó-nia inan; atu ó-nia loron sira bele naruk iha rai ne'ebé Na'i ó-nia Maromak fó ba ó.
answer_en: The fifth commandment is, Honor thy father and thy mother; that thy days may be long upon the land which the Lord thy God giveth thee.

question_tet: Saida mak hetan husu iha ukun-fuan dalima?
question_en: What is required in the fifth commandment?
answer_tet: Ukun-fuan dalima husu preserva onra, no hato'o dever sira, ne'ebé pertense ba ema hotu-hotu iha sira-nia fatin no relasaun oioin, nu'udar superior sira, inferiór sira, ka igul sira.
answer_en: The fifth commandment requireth the preserving the honor, and performing the duties, belonging to everyone in their several places and relations, as superiors, inferiors, or equals.

question_tet: Saida mak hetan proibí iha ukun-fuan dalima?
question_en: What is forbidden in the fifth commandment?
answer_tet: Ukun-fuan dalima proibí haluha, ka halo buat ruma hasoru, onra no dever ne'ebé pertense ba ema hotu-hotu iha sira-nia fatin no relasaun oioin.
answer_en: The fifth commandment forbiddeth the neglecting of, or doing anything against, the honor and duty which belongeth to everyone in their several places and relations.

question_tet: Saida mak razaun ne'ebé tanba ba ukun-fuan dalima?
question_en: What is the reason annexed to the fifth commandment?
answer_tet: Razaun ne'ebé tanba ba ukun-fuan dalima mak promesa hosi moris naruk no prosperidade (to'o iha ne'ebé nia sei servi ba Maromak nia glória no sira-nia di'ak rasik) ba ema hotu-hotu ne'ebé hali'is ukun-fuan ne'e.
answer_en: The reason annexed to the fifth commandment is, a promise of long life and prosperity (as far as it shall serve for God's glory and their own good) to all such as keep this commandment.

question_tet: Ukun-fuan ne'ebé mak ukun-fuan daneen?
question_en: Which is the sixth commandment?
answer_tet: Ukun-fuan daneen mak: Ó keta oho.
answer_en: The sixth commandment is, Thou shalt not kill.

question_tet: Saida mak hetan husu iha ukun-fuan daneen?
question_en: What is required in the sixth commandment?
answer_tet: Ukun-fuan daneen husu esfuersu legal hotu-hotu atu preserva ita-nia moris rasik, no ema seluk nia moris.
answer_en: The sixth commandment requireth all lawful endeavors to preserve our own life, and the life of others.

question_tet: Saida mak hetan proibí iha ukun-fuan daneen?
question_en: What is forbidden in the sixth commandment?
answer_tet: Ukun-fuan daneen proibí foti sai ita-nia moris rasik, ka ita-nia prosimu nia moris ho la justu, ka buat hotu-hotu ne'ebé tends ba ne'e.
answer_en: The sixth commandment forbiddeth the taking away of our own life, or the life of our neighbor unjustly, or whatsoever tendeth thereunto.

question_tet: Ukun-fuan ne'ebé mak ukun-fuan daseitu?
question_en: Which is the seventh commandment?
answer_tet: Ukun-fuan daseitu mak: Ó keta halo adultériu.
answer_en: The seventh commandment is, Thou shalt not commit adultery.

question_tet: Saida mak hetan husu iha ukun-fuan daseitu?
question_en: What is required in the seventh commandment?
answer_tet: Ukun-fuan daseitu husu preservasaun hosi ita-nia kasta rasik no ita-nia prosimu nia kasta, iha laran, liafuan, no hahalok.
answer_en: The seventh commandment requireth the preservation of our own and our neighbor's chastity, in heart, speech, and behavior.

question_tet: Saida mak hetan proibí iha ukun-fuan daseitu?
question_en: What is forbidden in the seventh commandment?
answer_tet: Ukun-fuan daseitu proibí hanoin, liafuan, no hahalok kasta-laek hotu-hotu.
answer_en: The seventh commandment forbiddeth all unchaste thoughts, words, and actions.

question_tet: Ukun-fuan ne'ebé mak ukun-fuan daualu?
question_en: Which is the eighth commandment?
answer_tet: Ukun-fuan daualu mak: Ó keta na'ok.
answer_en: The eighth commandment is, Thou shalt not steal.

question_tet: Saida mak hetan husu iha ukun-fuan daualu?
question_en: What is required in the eighth commandment?
answer_tet: Ukun-fuan daualu husu obtesaun no ba oin ne'ebé legal hosi rikusoin no kondisaun li'ur nian hosi ita-nia an rasik no ema seluk.
answer_en: The eighth commandment requireth the lawful procuring and furthering the wealth and outward estate of ourselves and others.

question_tet: Saida mak hetan proibí iha ukun-fuan daualu?
question_en: What is forbidden in the eighth commandment?
answer_tet: Ukun-fuan daualu proibí buat hotu-hotu ne'ebé ho la justu haraik ka bele haraik ita-nia rikusoin ka kondisaun li'ur nian, ka ita-nia prosimu nian.
answer_en: The eighth commandment forbiddeth whatsoever doth, or may, unjustly hinder our own, or our neighbor's wealth or outward estate.

question_tet: Ukun-fuan ne'ebé mak ukun-fuan dasia?
question_en: Which is the ninth commandment?
answer_tet: Ukun-fuan dasia mak: Ó keta fó sasin falsu hasoru ó-nia prosimu.
answer_en: The ninth commandment is, Thou shalt not bear false witness against thy neighbor.

question_tet: Saida mak hetan husu iha ukun-fuan dasia?
question_en: What is required in the ninth commandment?
answer_tet: Ukun-fuan dasia husu mantesaun no promosaun hosi lia-loos iha ema ho ema nia leet, no hosi ita-nia naran di'ak no ita-nia prosimu nia naran di'ak, liuliu iha fó sasin.
answer_en: The ninth commandment requireth the maintaining and promoting of truth between man and man, and of our own and our neighbor's good name, especially in witness-bearing.

question_tet: Saida mak hetan proibí iha ukun-fuan dasia?
question_en: What is forbidden in the ninth commandment?
answer_tet: Ukun-fuan dasia proibí buat hotu-hotu ne'ebé prejudikál ba lia-loos, ka aat ba ita-nia naran di'ak rasik, ka ita-nia prosimu nian.
answer_en: The ninth commandment forbiddeth whatsoever is prejudicial to truth, or injurious to our own, or our neighbor's, good name.

question_tet: Ukun-fuan ne'ebé mak ukun-fuan dakumi?
question_en: Which is the tenth commandment?
answer_tet: Ukun-fuan dakumi mak: Ó keta kaan ó-nia prosimu nia uma, ó keta kaan ó-nia prosimu nia feen, ka ninia atan-mane, ka ninia atan-feto, ka ninia karau, ka ninia kuda-burru, ka buat ruma ne'ebé mak ó-nia prosimu nian.
answer_en: The tenth commandment is, Thou shalt not covet thy neighbor's house, thou shalt not covet thy neighbor's wife, nor his manservant, nor his maidservant, nor his ox, nor his ass, nor any thing that is thy neighbor's.

question_tet: Saida mak hetan husu iha ukun-fuan dakumi?
question_en: What is required in the tenth commandment?
answer_tet: Ukun-fuan dakumi husu ksolok tomak ho ita-nia kondisaun rasik, ho koñesimentu no fuan domin nian ba ita-nia prosimu, no buat hotu-hotu ne'ebé mak ninian.
answer_en: The tenth commandment requireth full contentment with our own condition, with a right and charitable frame of spirit toward our neighbor, and all that is his.

question_tet: Ema bele kumpri tomak Maromak nia ukun-fuan sira ka?
question_en: Is any man able perfectly to keep the commandments of God?
answer_tet: Laiha ema baibain ida mehi hosi monu nian ba oin ne'ebé bele kumpri tomak Maromak nia ukun-fuan sira iha moris ne'e, maibé loron-loron harat sira iha hanoin, liafuan, no hahalok.
answer_en: No mere man since the fall is able in this life perfectly to keep the commandments of God, but doth daily break them in thought, word, and deed.

question_tet: Violasaun lei nian hotu-hotu aat no todan hanesan ka?
question_en: Are all transgressions of the law equally heinous?
answer_tet: Sala balun iha sira-nia an rasik, no tanba razaun hosi agravasaun oioin, aat tebes liu iha Maromak nia oin duké sala seluk sira.
answer_en: Some sins in themselves, and by reason of several aggravations, are more heinous in the sight of God than others.

question_tet: Sala kualker ida merese saida?
question_en: What doth every sin deserve?
answer_tet: Sala kualker ida merese Maromak nia hirus no malisan, maski iha moris ne'e no iha moris ne'ebé atu mai.
answer_en: Every sin deserveth God's wrath and curse, both in this life, and that which is to come.

question_tet: Saida mak Maromak husu hosi ita, atu ita bele halai hosi Ninia hirus no malisan ne'ebé merese ba ita tanba sala?
question_en: What doth God require of us, that we may escape his wrath and curse due to us for sin?
answer_tet: Atu halai hosi Maromak nia hirus no malisan ne'ebé merese ba ita tanba sala, Maromak husu hosi ita fiar iha Jesuis Kristu, arrepender ba moris, hamutuk ho uzu matan-moris hosi meius li'ur hotu-hotu liuhosi ne'ebé Kristu kunsede mai ita redensaun nia benefísiu sira.
answer_en: To escape the wrath and curse of God due to us for sin, God requireth of us faith in Jesus Christ, repentance unto life, with the diligent use of all the outward means whereby Christ communicateth to us the benefits of redemption.

question_tet: Saida mak fiar iha Jesuis Kristu?
question_en: What is faith in Jesus Christ?
answer_tet: Fiar iha Jesuis Kristu mak grasa salvasaun nian ida, liuhosi ne'e ita simu no deskansa iha Nia mesak de'it ba salvasaun, hanesan Nia hetan fó gratuitamentu mai ita iha evanjellu.
answer_en: Faith in Jesus Christ is a saving grace, whereby we receive and rest upon him alone for salvation, as he is offered to us in the gospel.

question_tet: Saida mak arrepender ba moris?
question_en: What is repentance unto life?
answer_tet: Arrepender ba moris mak grasa salvasaun nian ida, liuhosi ne'e ema sala-la'ek ida, hosi sensu loloos kona-ba ninia sala, no kompreensaun hosi Maromak nia misericórdia iha Kristu, ho tanis no odiu ba ninia sala, fila hosi ne'e ba Maromak, ho propózitu tomak no esfuersu ba obediénsia foun.
answer_en: Repentance unto life is a saving grace, whereby a sinner, out of a true sense of his sin, and apprehension of the mercy of God in Christ, doth, with grief and hatred of his sin, turn from it unto God, with full purpose of, and endeavor after, new obedience.

question_tet: Saida mak meius li'ur no baibain nian liuhosi ne'ebé Kristu kunsede mai ita redensaun nia benefísiu sira?
question_en: What are the outward and ordinary means whereby Christ communicateth to us the benefits of redemption?
answer_tet: Meius li'ur no baibain nian liuhosi ne'ebé Kristu kunsede mai ita redensaun nia benefísiu sira, mak Ninia ordenansa sira, liuliu Liafuan, sakramentu sira, no orasaun; sira-ne'e hotu sai efetivu ba ema hili-sira ba salvasaun.
answer_en: The outward and ordinary means whereby Christ communicateth to us the benefits of redemption, are his ordinances, especially the Word, sacraments, and prayer; all which are made effectual to the elect for salvation.

question_tet: Oinsá mak Liafuan sai efetivu ba salvasaun?
question_en: How is the Word made effectual to salvation?
answer_tet: Maromak nia Espíritu halo lee nian, maibé liuliu pregasaun Liafuan nian, sai meius efetivu ida atu konvense no konverte ema sala-sira, no harii sira ba oin iha santidade no ksolok, liuhosi fiar, ba salvasaun.
answer_en: The Spirit of God maketh the reading, but especially the preaching of the Word, an effectual means of convincing and converting sinners, and of building them up in holiness and comfort, through faith, unto salvation.

question_tet: Oinsá mak tenke lee no rona Liafuan, atu nia bele sai efetivu ba salvasaun?
question_en: How is the Word to be read and heard, that it may become effectual to salvation?
answer_tet: Atu Liafuan bele sai efetivu ba salvasaun, ita tenke attends ba ne'e ho matan-moris, preparasaun, no orasaun; simu nia ho fiar no domin, rai nia iha ita-nia laran, no prátika nia iha ita-nia moris.
answer_en: That the Word may become effectual to salvation, we must attend thereunto with diligence, preparation, and prayer; receive it with faith and love, lay it up in our hearts, and practice it in our lives.

question_tet: Oinsá mak sakramentu sira sai meius efetivu ba salvasaun?
question_en: How do the sacraments become effectual means of salvation?
answer_tet: Sakramentu sira sai meius efetivu ba salvasaun, la'ós hosi virtude ruma iha sira, ka iha ema ne'ebé administra sira; maibé de'it liuhosi Kristu nia bensan, no servisu hosi Ninia Espíritu iha sira-ne'ebé simu sira ho fiar.
answer_en: The sacraments become effectual means of salvation, not from any virtue in them, or in him that doth administer them; but only by the blessing of Christ, and the working of his Spirit in them that by faith receive them.

question_tet: Saida mak sakramentu ida?
question_en: What is a sacrament?
answer_tet: Sakramentu ida mak ordenansa santu ida ne'ebé hatato'o hosi Kristu; iha ne'e, liuhosi sinal ne'ebé haree ho matan, Kristu no benefísiu sira hosi aliansa foun hetan reprezenta, selu no aplika ba ema fiar-sira.
answer_en: A sacrament is a holy ordinance instituted by Christ; wherein, by sensible signs, Christ, and the benefits of the new covenant, are represented, sealed, and applied to believers.

question_tet: Sakramentu sira-ne'ebé mak iha Testamentu Foun?
question_en: Which are the sacraments of the New Testament?
answer_tet: Sakramentu sira hosi Testamentu Foun mak Batizmu no Na'i nia Hahan.
answer_en: The sacraments of the New Testament are, Baptism, and the Lord's Supper.

question_tet: Saida mak batizmu?
question_en: What is baptism?
answer_tet: Batizmu mak sakramentu ida hosi Testamentu Foun, liuhosi ne'e fihir bee iha Aman, no Oan-Mane, no Espíritu Santu nia naran, mehi no selu ita-nia foti sai ba iha Kristu, no partisipasaun iha benefísiu sira hosi aliansa grasa nian, no ita-nia dedikasaun an ba Na'i.
answer_en: Baptism is a sacrament of the New Testament, wherein the washing with water in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost, doth signify and seal our ingrafting into Christ, and partaking of the benefits of the covenant of grace, and our engagement to be the Lord's.

question_tet: Sé de'it mak tenke hetan administra batizmu?
question_en: To whom is baptism to be administered?
answer_tet: Batizmu la'ós atu hetan administra ba ema ruma ne'ebé iha li'ur hosi kireja visível, to'o sira professa sira-nia fiar iha Kristu, no obediénsia ba Nia; maibé kosok-oan sira hosi ema sira ne'ebé nu'udar membru hosi kireja visível tenke hetan batiza.
answer_en: Baptism is not to be administered to any that are out of the visible church, till they profess their faith in Christ, and obedience to him; but the infants of such as are members of the visible church are to be baptized.

question_tet: Saida mak Na'i nia Hahan?
question_en: What is the Lord's Supper?
answer_tet: Na'i nia Hahan mak sakramentu ida hosi Testamentu Foun, liuhosi ne'e, liuhosi fó no simu paun no tua-uvas tuir Kristu nia hatato'o, Ninia mate hetan hatudu sai; no simu-na'in sira ne'ebé merese hetan mehi sai partisipante iha Ninia isin no ran, ho Ninia benefísiu hotu-hotu, ba sira-nia nuri espíritu nian no naruk iha grasa.
answer_en: The Lord's Supper is a sacrament of the New Testament, wherein, by giving and receiving bread and wine, according to Christ's appointment, his death is showed forth; and the worthy receivers are, not after a corporal and carnal manner, but by faith, made partakers of his body and blood, with all his benefits, to their spiritual nourishment, and growth in grace.

question_tet: Saida mak hetan husu atu simu Na'i nia Hahan ho merese?
question_en: What is required to the worthy receiving of the Lord's Supper?
answer_tet: Husu ba sira-ne'ebé atu simu Na'i nia Hahan ho merese, atu examina sira-nia an rasik kona-ba sira-nia koñesimentu atu diskerne Na'i nia isin, kona-ba sira-nia fiar atu han iha Nia, sira-nia arrepender, domin, no obediénsia foun; keta atu mai ho la merese, no han no hemu juízu ba sira-nia an.
answer_en: It is required of them that would worthily partake of the Lord's Supper, that they examine themselves of their knowledge to discern the Lord's body, of their faith to feed upon him, of their repentance, love, and new obedience; lest, coming unworthily, they eat and drink judgment to themselves.

question_tet: Saida mak orasaun?
question_en: What is prayer?
answer_tet: Orasaun mak foti sai ita-nia hakarak sira ba Maromak, ba buat sira-ne'ebé tuir Ninia hakarak, iha Kristu nia naran, ho konfesa ita-nia sala sira, no agradesimentu naksobu ba Ninia misericórdia sira.
answer_en: Prayer is an offering up of our desires unto God, for things agreeable to his will, in the name of Christ, with confession of our sins, and thankful acknowledgment of his mercies.

question_tet: Regra ne'ebé mak Maromak fó tiha ba ita-nia dirijikasaun iha orasaun?
question_en: What rule hath God given for our direction in prayer?
answer_tet: Maromak nia Liafuan tomak mak valiózu atu dirije ita iha orasaun; maibé regra espesiál dirijikasaun nian mak orasaun ne'ebé Kristu hanorin Ninia diskípulu sira, ne'ebé baibain hanaran Na'i nia Orasaun.
answer_en: The whole word of God is of use to direct us in prayer; but the special rule of direction is that form of prayer which Christ taught his disciples, commonly called The Lord's Prayer.

question_tet: Saida mak Na'i nia Orasaun nia lia-maklokek hanorin ita?
question_en: What doth the preface of the Lord's prayer teach us?
answer_tet: Na'i nia Orasaun nia lia-maklokek, ne'ebé mak, "Ita-nia Aman ne'ebé iha lalehan", hanorin ita atu hakbesik ba Maromak ho respeitu santu no konfiansa tomak, hanesan oan sira ba aman ne'ebé bele no prontu atu ajuda ita; no katak ita tenke reza ho no ba ema seluk sira.
answer_en: The preface of the Lord's prayer, which is, Our Father which art in heaven, teacheth us to draw near to God with all holy reverence and confidence, as children to a father, able and ready to help us; and that we should pray with and for others.

question_tet: Saida mak ita reza iha petisaun dahuluk?
question_en: What do we pray for in the first petition?
answer_tet: Iha petisaun dahuluk, ne'ebé mak, "Santu kaer Ó-nia naran", ita reza atu Maromak bele kapasita ita no ema seluk sira atu fó glória ba Nia iha buat hotu-hotu ne'ebé liuhosi ne'e Nia halo Ninia an hetan koñese; no atu Nia bele disponne buat hotu-hotu ba Ninia glória rasik.
answer_en: In the first petition, which is, Hallowed be thy name, we pray that God would enable us, and others, to glorify him in all that whereby he maketh himself known; and that he would dispose all things to his own glory.

question_tet: Saida mak ita reza iha petisaun daruak?
question_en: What do we pray for in the second petition?
answer_tet: Iha petisaun daruak, ne'ebé mak, "Ó-nia Reinu mai", ita reza atu Satanás nia reinu hetan harat; no atu grasa nia reinu bele hetan ba oin, ita-nia an no ema seluk hetan lori tama ba iha ne'e no hela iha ne'e; no atu glória nia reinu bele mai hodi lalais.
answer_en: In the second petition, which is, Thy kingdom come, we pray that Satan's kingdom may be destroyed; and that the kingdom of grace may be advanced, ourselves and others brought into it, and kept in it; and that the kingdom of glory may be hastened.

question_tet: Saida mak ita reza iha petisaun datolu?
question_en: What do we pray for in the third petition?
answer_tet: Iha petisaun datolu, ne'ebé mak, "Ó-nia hakarak hetan halo iha rai hanesan iha lalehan", ita reza atu Maromak, liuhosi Ninia grasa, bele halo ita prontu no kapasitu atu hatene, obedese, no submite ba Ninia hakarak iha buat hotu-hotu, hanesan anju sira halo iha lalehan.
answer_en: In the third petition, which is, Thy will be done in earth, as it is in heaven, we pray that God, by his grace, would make us able and willing to know, obey, and submit to his will in all things, as the angels do in heaven.

question_tet: Saida mak ita reza iha petisaun dafaat?
question_en: What do we pray for in the fourth petition?
answer_tet: Iha petisaun dafaat, ne'ebé mak, "Fó mai ita loron ne'e ita-nia paun loron-loron nian", ita reza atu hosi Maromak nia prezente gratuitu ita bele simu mehi sufisiente hosi buat di'ak sira iha moris ne'e nian, no goza Ninia bensan ho sira-ne'e.
answer_en: In the fourth petition, which is, Give us this day our daily bread, we pray that of God's free gift we may receive a competent portion of the good things of this life, and enjoy his blessing with them.

question_tet: Saida mak ita reza iha petisaun dalima?
question_en: What do we pray for in the fifth petition?
answer_tet: Iha petisaun dalima, ne'ebé mak, "Perdua ita-nia dívida sira, hanesan ita perdua ita-nia deve-na'in sira", ita reza atu Maromak, tanba Kristu nia mehi, perdua gratuitamentu ita-nia sala hotu-hotu; ne'ebé ita hetan korafe atu husu, tanba liuhosi Ninia grasa ita hetan kapasita hosi laran atu perdua ema seluk sira.
answer_en: In the fifth petition, which is, And forgive us our debts, as we forgive our debtors, we pray that God, for Christ's sake, would freely pardon all our sins; which we are the rather encouraged to ask, because by his grace we are enabled from the heart to forgive others.

question_tet: Saida mak ita reza iha petisaun daneen?
question_en: What do we pray for in the sixth petition?
answer_tet: Iha petisaun daneen, ne'ebé mak, "Keta lori ita ba tentasaun, maibé liberta ita hosi aat", ita reza atu Maromak bele mehi keta husik ita hetan tenta ba sala, ka kuandu hetan tenta, bele sustenta no liberta ita.
answer_en: In the sixth petition, which is, And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil, we pray that God would either keep us from being tempted to sin, or support and deliver us when we are tempted.

question_tet: Saida mak Na'i nia Orasaun nia konklusaun hanorin ita?
question_en: What doth the conclusion of the Lord's prayer teach us?
answer_tet: Na'i nia Orasaun nia konklusaun, ne'ebé mak, "Tanba Reinu, no podér, no glória mak Ó-nian ba nafatin. Ámen", hanorin ita atu foti ita-nia korafe iha orasaun hosi Maromak mesak de'it, no iha ita-nia orasaun sira atu hahi'i Nia, atribuindu reinu, podér, no glória ba Nia; no iha sasin hosi ita-nia hakarak no garantia atu hetan rona, ita dehan, Ámen.
answer_en: The conclusion of the Lord's prayer, which is, For thine is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, forever. Amen, teacheth us to take our encouragement in prayer from God only, and in our prayers to praise him, ascribing kingdom, power, and glory to him; and in testimony of our desire, and assurance to be heard, we say, Amen.

question_tet: Saida mak significadu hosi liafuan Ámen?
question_en: What is the meaning of the word Amen?
answer_tet: Liafuan Ámen significa katak iha garantia no fiar tomak, ita-nia orasaun hetan rona hosi Maromak no sei hetan resposta tuir Ninia hakarak.
answer_en: The word Amen signifieth that in full assurance and faith, our prayer is heard by God and will be answered according to his will.
